# Respec Labs

> Respec Labs (respeclabs.com) is a game development consultancy founded by Daniele Nanni, a creative and game director with 25+ years in the games industry. It offers game studio consulting, fractional (interim) design leadership, career coaching for professionals, academic advisory for game design schools and programs, and mentoring for students and recent graduates. Tagline: "It's time to level up."

## Founder
- Daniele Nanni (Dan Nanni), Founder & Principal Consultant
- Credits include Starfield, Fallout 76, Battlefield 4, Killzone 3, and Star Wars Battlefront II
- Studios: Bethesda, EA, Sony, Tencent, Gearbox
- Languages: English and Italian
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dnanni/

## Services
- Studio Strategist (for studios and dev teams): consulting and fractional design leadership, including team structure, hiring strategy, project direction, scope and milestone planning, and interim leadership
- Pro Coach (for working and between-jobs professionals): next-role and promotion strategy, leadership growth, résumé and portfolio reviews, interview prep
- Academy Advisor (for schools and programs): curriculum advising, program consulting, workshops, guest lectures
- Student Mentor (for students and new grads, at a student rate): academic and career direction, project and portfolio feedback, getting hire-ready with résumé reviews and interview prep

## How engagements work
1. Free intro call
2. A plan with goals, priorities, and a scope of work that fits the team, timeline, and budget
3. Hands-on consulting, leadership, coaching, or mentoring with regular check-ins
